name: 14467 · Henrietta, NY
findings: ZIP 14467 (Henrietta) has 33 nonprofit organizations. 21 of them (64%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 18 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (42% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 14467 (Henrietta) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 14467 (Henrietta) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 66% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 14 organizations here; 27% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?
